// Get output from the Nagios SSH node const output = $json.stdout || ''; const lines = output .split('\n') .map(line => line.trim()) .filter(line => line.length > 0); // Categorize Nagios events const critical = []; const down = []; const unreachable = []; const errors = []; const warnings = []; for (const line of lines) { const upper = line.toUpperCase(); if (upper.includes('CRITICAL')) { critical.push(line); } if (upper.includes('DOWN')) { down.push(line); } if (upper.includes('UNREACHABLE')) { unreachable.push(line); } if (upper.includes('ERROR') || upper.includes('FAILED')) { errors.push(line); } if (upper.includes('WARNING')) { warnings.push(line); } } // Escape HTML characters function escapeHtml(text) { return text .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"') .replace(/'/g, '''); } // Create HTML rows function createRows(items, status) { if (items.length === 0) { return ` No ${status} events detected. `; } return items.map((line, index) => ` ${index + 1} ${escapeHtml(line)} `).join(''); } // Summary counts const totalProblems = critical.length + down.length + unreachable.length + errors.length; const totalWarnings = warnings.length; const overallStatus = totalProblems > 0 ? 'CRITICAL' : totalWarnings > 0 ? 'WARNING' : 'HEALTHY'; // Complete HTML email const html = ` Nagios Alert Report

Nagios Monitoring Alert Report

Critical / Warning / Host Availability Summary

Dear IT Team,

Please find below the latest Nagios Monitoring Alert Summary.

Report Time ${new Date().toLocaleString('en-IN', { timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' })}
Overall Status ${overallStatus}
Total Critical Problems ${totalProblems}
Total Warnings ${totalWarnings}

Nagios Alert Categories

  • CRITICAL – Critical service failures requiring attention
  • DOWN – Host/service reported as down
  • UNREACHABLE – Host/network destination unreachable
  • ERROR / FAILED – Monitoring or service errors
  • WARNING – Potential or developing issues

CRITICAL Events

${createRows(critical, 'CRITICAL')}
# Nagios Event

HOST / SERVICE DOWN Events

${createRows(down, 'DOWN')}
# Nagios Event

UNREACHABLE Events

${createRows(unreachable, 'UNREACHABLE')}
# Nagios Event

ERROR / FAILED Events

${createRows(errors, 'ERROR / FAILED')}
# Nagios Event

WARNING Events

${createRows(warnings, 'WARNING')}
# Nagios Event

Nagios Raw Output

${escapeHtml(output || 'No Nagios output received.')}

Action Required: Please review the above Nagios alerts and take appropriate corrective action for CRITICAL, DOWN, UNREACHABLE and ERROR/FAILED events.

Monitoring Note: Repeated CRITICAL or UNREACHABLE events may indicate server, network, service, storage, or infrastructure problems and should be investigated immediately.

Regards,
IT Team
Ninestars Information Technologies Pvt Ltd

This is an automated Nagios monitoring report generated by n8n. Please do not reply to this automated email.
`; // Return data for Microsoft Outlook / Graph email node return [ { json: { graphBody: { message: { subject: `Nagios Alert Report - ${overallStatus} - ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}`, body: { contentType: 'HTML', content: html }, toRecipients: [ { emailAddress: { address: 'prem.d@ninestars.in' } } ] }, saveToSentItems: true }, nagios_summary: { overall_status: overallStatus, critical_count: critical.length, down_count: down.length, unreachable_count: unreachable.length, error_failed_count: errors.length, warning_count: warnings.length, total_problem_count: totalProblems, total_warning_count: totalWarnings } } } ];
